title: Preserve SwiftPM CLI resource bundles during Vaporize installs
closeReason: The resource-bundle install path and CUJ-22 proving ground were completed, with the release-doctor receipt refreshed by commit 46304c31.
createdBy: codex after chairman asked to make SwiftPM CLI resource installs work for Vaporize launch review

historicalContent.sourceLocation: Codex session 2026-07-05: chairman requested Vaporize launch-review readiness after asking how to make SwiftPM CLI resources and Info.plist/version/build metadata work outside Xcode CLI projects.
historicalContent.description: Vaporize CLI installs must preserve SwiftPM target resource bundles used by Bundle.module when a product is installed into ~/.swiftpm/bin. Vaporize should keep SwiftPM experimental-install as the executable primitive, ask SwiftPM for the products directory with swift build --show-bin-path, copy direct .bundle siblings into the installed CLI bin directory, and document the separate product metadata Info.plist sidecar boundary.
acceptanceCriteria: FR-032 defines SwiftPM CLI resource-bundle install preservation in the PRD.
CUJ-22 defines the resource-bearing CLI install journey and proof boundary.
GATE-39 records the resource CLI install gate with final-release and Sparkle boundaries.
VaporizeCUJ22ResourceCLIInstallTests proves a simulation proving-ground manifest, missing-scenario expected-fail coverage audit, and Vaporize expected-pass behavior away from .build.
vaporize.engineering.docc/swiftpm-cli-resource-bundle-installs.md documents Bundle.module, experimental-install, show-bin-path, resource bundle copying, and metadata Info.plist sidecars.
Release Doctor checks FR-032, CUJ-22, GATE-39, the engineering doc, launch-review packet references, and CUJ-22 coverage.
Launch-review and provenance artifacts name the CUJ-22 proof and keep final release blockers honest.
